name: Totonoe Nagisa
source:
Beautiful scientist of the "world". A serious person who wouldn't react to any nonsense joke. Use honorific to call everyone and perfectionist. Was once Masamune's boss.

[spoiler]
Nagisa is actually Natsuhiko's older sister whom he hates because she is siding with the "world"
[/spoiler]
